title: Dry Soda Blasting
contentHtml:
Industrial Dry Soda Blasting for ACC & ACHE Fin-Tube Bundle Cleaning

ICS provides specialized dry soda blasting services for air-cooled heat exchangers, fin-fan units, and air-cooled condensers across the USA. Our non-destructive cleaning process removes fouling, scale, and contaminants from tube bundles — restoring thermal capacity and extending equipment lifespan without taking your system offline.

Explore Air Coolers

Fouled Heat Exchangers Are Reducing Your Cooling Capacity

Fin-fans and air-cooled heat exchangers are widely used across oil, gas, refining, chemical, and power generation facilities. When fin-tube bundles accumulate fouling, airflow restriction leads to greatly reduced performance and higher energy consumption.

This buildup often includes grease, dust, oxidation layers, and surface contaminants that require non-destructive cleaning method solutions rather than traditional sandblasting or chemical solvents.

Keeping your ACHE clean is essential for operational stability. ICS uses dry soda blasting as a natural rust inhibitor-based cleaning approach to maintain performance without damaging delicate substrates.

Need to improve your ACHE performance by up to 40%? Request a Quote today.

Request a Quote

Increase ACHE Performance Without Buying New Equipment

There are several ways to recover ACHE efficiency without capital investment. ICS provides a modern cleaning solution using soda media and blasting applications designed for industrial heat transfer systems.

Cleaning the tube bundle is one of the most effective ways to increase ACHE duty. Fin-tube rows often contain light surface rust, abrasive remains, and embedded contaminants that are not visible externally.

Our crew uses soda blasting with carefully controlled blast pressure and compressed air flow from industrial air compressor systems to ensure deep cleaning without damaging bare metal surfaces

Dry soda blasting successfully removes impurities and debris from fin tube bundles while maintaining the structural integrity of the cooling bundles. 

Inspection and assessment

The fin-tube bundle is visually inspected to determine fouling level, underlying surface condition, and presence of rust or coating damage requiring protective coating consideration.

Equipment Setup

Our equipment is configured, including a blast pot, a blast hose, and a soda blaster system calibration based on desired blast pressure and substrate sensitivity. Correct soda blasting media is selected for softer substrates such as aluminum fins or carbon fiber components.

Monitoring and Adjustment

Technicians continuously monitor inadequate air supply risks, nozzle distance, and blast pressure stability to ensure efficient removal of contaminants without damaging delicate materials.

Post-Blast Inspection and Cleanup

After cleaning, all fouling is removed. The process leaves no abrasive residue because sodium bicarbonate is water-soluble and non-hazardous, preventing flash rusting and ensuring clean bare metal exposure.

Reporting and Documentation

ICS records cleaning conditions, equipment response, and surface results to support maintenance planning and future performance optimization.

Schedule Technical Consultation

Our Dry Soda Blast Cleaning Process

ICS Dry Soda Blasting | Proven Results

Our performance data shows measurable improvement in airflow and thermal efficiency after cleaning. Systems show recovery in heat transfer capacity due to removal of surface contamination, grease buildup, and rust inhibitor breakdown layers.

Why Choose ICS Dry Soda Blast Cleaning Services?

ICS replaces outdated chemical cleaning and traditional sandblasting methods with controlled soda blasting technology used across industries including food processing equipment cleaning, fire restoration environments, and industrial maintenance systems.

Advanced Equipment

ICS operates industrial-grade soda blasting equipment calibrated for heat exchanger applications. Our specialized systems deliver consistent blast pressure and controlled media flow for uniform cleaning across the full tube bundle.

Sodium Bicarbonate Blast Media

We use industrial-grade sodium bicarbonate soda blast media to break up fouling without damaging fins or tubes. This soft abrasive is non-toxic, water-soluble, and safe for use on sensitive industrial surfaces and soft metals, including operations in environmentally controlled facilities.

Environment-friendly cleaning process

Dry soda blasting is non-corrosive, non-hazardous, and leaves no chemical residue. Sodium bicarbonate is blasted into the system dry and disperses harmlessly without producing wastewater or requiring chemical containment, keeping your facility environmentally compliant.

No Workflow Disruption

We perform dry soda blasting while your unit is running, eliminating shutdowns and special unit preparation. No confined space entry is required. Our crew works from ground level, reducing safety permitting concerns and protecting your production schedule.

Immediate Results

Performance improvements are measurable as fouling is removed during the blasting operation. Your control room will register increased airflow immediately. We document all results before and after cleaning so your team can verify the outcome.

Because it is a non-destructive process, it is suitable for delicate industrial systems where maintaining surface integrity is critical for long-term performance.

Request Cleaning Proposal

A Controlled Alternative to Traditional Blasting Methods

Traditional abrasive blasting methods such as sandblasting or aluminum oxide blasting use aggressive media that can damage bare metal surfaces and delicate substrates.

Dry ice blasting behaves differently and relies on thermal shock rather than abrasion.

Dry soda blasting provides a balanced solution using soft abrasive media that ensures quality surface preparation without damaging coatings or substrates.

ICS selects the method based on contamination type, equipment condition, and industrial blasting applications.

Contact With ICS Specialists

Schedule Dry Soda Blasting for Your Heat Exchanger System

If your ACHE system, fin fan cooler, or industrial heat exchanger is experiencing reduced performance due to fouling or airflow restriction, ICS can provide a targeted dry soda blasting solution.

We deliver reliable industrial cleaning services across the USA with a focus on performance restoration and equipment protection.

Request Industrial Assessment
